answer_1: The limit as x approaches -1 does not exist because the left- and right-hand limits differ, while the limit as x approaches 3 is +infinity.
answer_2: Both limits exist: the limit as x approaches -1 is -infinity and the limit as x approaches 3 is +infinity.
answer_3: Neither limit exists because the function has vertical asymptotes at both x = -1 and x = 3.
answer_4: The limit as x approaches -1 is +infinity because the right-hand limit is +infinity, while the limit as x approaches 3 does not exist.
correct_answer: The limit as x approaches -1 does not exist because the left- and right-hand limits differ, while the limit as x approaches 3 is +infinity.
